book.name: EFESUS
book.title: EFESUS Efesus mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge kuyarna

content: Sine Kristus mbolŋge kuasmbi ndindo mineg
Ye Suŋgo tuku piro taŋgo ye muli wandek sinamŋge minet te ye tane sarsartiŋget. Kuate nu tane wikina wam ta te-mayokmba mine mayenu mbolŋge minap.
Tane taŋgine nyu te-ibeŋmba ŋgan maŋau ŋak minap sulumba ande tuku pitik gubra te ndakap. Tane kume pur maŋau dubimba afu nane maŋau kise dubide ta tala ndaniŋgap.
Tukul Guwa mbolŋge tane wamdus ulendi minig. Tane maŋau ta pur ndakuwa ŋga wamdus mukuk maŋau minam tuku wamdus saŋgrinu palpe.
Sine Tukul Guwa ndindo ŋak minmba ŋgarosu ndindo ndo mineg. Kuate nu sine wam ndindo tairŋga minam tuku wikina.
Sine tuku Suŋgo ndindo. Ŋgamuŋgal son ndindo. Sine kule pisne ndindo teg.
Sine tuku Mbara ndindo. Nu sine ŋakmba tuku Mam ndindo minit. Nu sine ŋakmba kulatka sine ŋakmba mbolŋge pirokate. Nu sine ŋakmba tuku ŋgamuŋgal sinamŋge minit.
Kristus nu nuŋe wamdus dubimba sine nduik nduik ŋakmba mbolŋge saŋgri yimyam siŋgina.
Kuyar pasa ande ta tuku teŋenmba sakate.

content.text: Nu muliŋ kilanu mbal kilmba samba mbol ambe kina. Ambeŋge nuŋe wam kame magenu taŋgo kame niŋgina ŋga sakate. Mune 68.18

content: Kuyar pasa ta nu mbol ambe kina ŋga sakate ta tugunu teŋenmba. Nu amboŋga kilke te o sinam nzi kina sulumba nu maŋ luka samba mbol kina.
Ande nu ndekina ta nu samba mbol ambe kumba maŋ tuturmba o mbol ambe kina le kile agaŋ ndende ŋakmba nu kumnemŋge minig.

Nu sine afu aposel pirokam tuku saŋgri siŋgina sulumba afu Tukul Guwa tugumŋge pasa ismba kile-mayokkam tuku piro siŋgina. Afu lika pasa mayenu kukliwam tuku, afu Kuate tuku mbal kulatkam tuku, afu nuŋe pasa kukliwam tuku taŋamba taŋamba saŋgri yimyam siŋgina.
Sine Kuate tuku mbal pirokube le Kristus tuku ŋgarosu suŋgoka saŋgri tiŋguwa ŋga nu taŋana.
Sine taŋamba minbe ma ma ŋgamuŋgal son saŋgrinu kumu kumu mayok ka Kuate tuku Kiŋo kila pile mayebe sulumba ka ka sugoka sine Kristus minit taŋaŋ mayok kaŋgig.

Taŋamba mayok kab ta sine kiŋo kame taŋaŋ mine ndaka tum pasa kise kise taŋgo naŋgine yabri wamdus kilambi tugusek pasa taŋaŋ kile-mayokkuwaig ta ismba bubre tiŋga yu toŋgel tiŋgate taŋaŋ wamdus kine inume nda.
Sine taŋgo ŋakmba idusniŋmba tugusek maŋau ndo dubibe sulumba wam ŋakmba mbolŋge siŋgine Gabat Kristus ndoŋ ulendikube.

Sine Kristus tuku ŋgarosu mineg. Nu nuŋe ŋgarosu kulatka saŋgri tuwit le nuŋe ŋgarosu ŋakmba ulendika mine mayede. Nane naŋgine piro yimyam tugusemba kuwaig ta ŋgarosu suŋgoka kume pur maŋau ŋak minmba saŋgri tiŋgamŋgat.
Sine Kristus mbolŋge mine maŋau kitek ŋak
Ye pasa te Suŋgo tuku nyu mbolŋge satiŋgamŋgit ta tane ise mayewap. Kile tane Kuate dubi ndade mbal taŋaŋ li ndakap. Nane naŋgine wamdus wam alo kugatok mbolŋge patikade le
ma make suŋgo sinamŋge minig. Nane ŋgamuŋgal kareŋnu pilmba wamdus kugatok taŋaŋ minmba Kuate nu maŋau kitek taŋgo niŋgit ta nane gilai minig.
Nane maŋau ŋaigonu kumba kiko kugatok minig. Nane naŋgine nzali ŋgail ndaka une maŋau kumba kutur maŋau ŋakmba kam tuku piriride.
i ... Tane taŋamba Kristus tuku kila pile ndakinaig.
Afuŋge tane Yesus tuku pasa kuklimba tumtiŋginaig le ismba nu tuku tugusek wam kila pilnaig.
Tane kila pilnaig taŋamba taŋgine wamdus ambokok tambi maŋau ŋaigonu dubikinaig ta kusrekap. Taŋgine wamdus ambokok taŋge tane ŋaigo siglike dirna.
Tane wamdus kitek ŋak minmba
Kuate tuku maŋau te-purap sulumba tugusek maŋau ndo dubimba mine mayenu mbolŋge minap.
Tane taŋgo kitek minmba yabri pasa sa ndakap. Sine ŋakmba Kristus tuku ŋgarosu inumnu mineg tukunu tira ndoŋ siŋka pasa ndo sakap.
Tane gubra tap sulumba gubra ta dubimba une ke ndakap. Tane ki mbol gubra tumba gubra ta ŋak kinye ndakap.
Satan pirokam tuku ndin wakei ndawap.
Ande nu agaŋ ndende kuayarte ta nu maŋau ta kusrewa. Nu afu agaŋ ndende denkanu minig ta turkam tuku piro kareŋkuwa.
Tane pasa ŋaigonu sa ndakap. Pasa magenu ta ndo sakap le nane afu wamdus piti ŋak minig ta pasa ta ismba saŋgri pileniŋguwa.
Kuate tuku Tukul Guwa piti ser ndawap. Kuate nu tane tuku muskil kile-tidiŋgam saka Tukul Guwa tiŋmba saŋgatiŋgina.
Wamdus ŋgueu ŋak, gubra maŋau, miŋge fetka kualeyau maŋau, waŋe pasa ta ŋakmba kusrekap.
Tane taŋgine taŋgine muŋgu sina ŋak minap sulumba muŋgu turkap. Kuate nu Kristus mbolŋge tane tuku une sauka gilaiŋgina taŋamba ndo taŋgine taŋgine mbolŋge mbarde ta mata gilaiŋgap.
